raw_response:
I am old now, 60 years. I never went to school but I farm these 5.5 mu my whole life. My husband and me, just two of us. My back hurts but I still work the field.

Stevia — we call it tiánjú. I grow it maybe 8, 9 years now. The company give us seedlings and buy back the dry leaves. That is why I plant it, not wheat-maize like before. Price is better if leaves are green and clean.

Last year I used 2 bags of compound fertilizer per mu before transplant — that is 100 jin, 50 kg. The bag say 15-15-15, the dealer tell me. Then after first cutting I put urea, maybe half bag per mu, 20 jin. After second cutting same thing. My neighbor Old Wang do like this and his leaves look good, so I follow.

This year I do the same. Change is scary. Last year leaves sold okay, about 200 kg dry per mu. If I cut fertilizer I lose money, and fertilizer cost is already 300+ yuan per mu. Better put enough.

Water — I have well. Stevia need water, especially after transplant and after each cutting. I irrigate maybe 5, 6 times. When leaves droop in afternoon I know is time.

Pesticide — stevia not too many bugs but sometimes aphid, sometimes leaf spot. I spray 2, maybe 3 times. The company man come and tell us which medicine, I buy from dealer.

Ploughing — I pay the tractor man to rotary till before transplant, 40 yuan per mu. My body cannot do by hand anymore.

Seedlings come from company, improved kind, high stevioside they say. I don't understand but leaves are good.
